notes.title: JAZZ OUT Update#1
notes.content:
Hello everyone! We're so happy that you enjoyed our game and gave us very valuable feedback <3 

Here're some small tweaks and fixes we made:

[list]
[*] Level timer should now start whenever the player starts moving.
[*] Tutorial should now only appear in Story Mode and only once per session.
[*] Minor tweaks on 'Rhythm Road' to improve performance.
[*] Minor UI bugs squashed.
[/list]

Enjoy your escape,
Team Sax Appeal
